title: Wise Words
subtitle: Motivational Quotes for iOS
description: A motivational quote app for saving and sharing favorites, built as my final school project for the iOS course.
descriptionLong: Wise Words is a motivational quotes app developed using Swift and SwiftUI. It features a clean and intuitive interface, allowing users to discover, save, and share their favorite quotes effortlessly. Key technical highlights include MVVM architecture for maintainability, SwiftData for efficient data storage, asynchronous programming for smooth user experience, custom animations for transitions, comprehensive unit and UI testing, widget support for home screen quotes, swipe gestures for navigation, and SwiftUI's environment and state management for dynamic updates.

title: Morgon- & kvällsåminnelser
subtitle: Morning and Eveningsupplication with Swedish Translation
description: Morning and eveningsupplications in Swedish, Arabic & Transliteration.
descriptionLong: Morgon & Kvällsåminnelser is a React Native app built with Expo, offering morning and evening reminders through a user-friendly interface. It uses MVVM architecture, AsyncStorage for data storage, and Expo Router for navigation. Custom animations, haptic feedback (expo-haptics), and real-time updates via React hooks enhance the experience. Styled with Tailwind CSS, the app ensures simplicity and responsiveness.

title: Coinnect Four
subtitle: Coin-Themed Mobile App for Android
description: A multiplayer Connect Four game with a unique coin theme, developed for my Android course final project.
descriptionLong: Me and my friend Lavdim developed Coinnect Four, a coin-themed Connect Four mobile app for Android leveraging Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. I crafted an intuitive UI in Figma and implemented it using custom Composable functions to achieve smooth, responsive gameplay. The app follows an MVVM architecture, leveraging Android Architecture Components such as ViewModel and LiveData to separate concerns and manage UI state efficiently. For asynchronous tasks, Kotlin coroutines ensure that data operations and UI updates remain fluid, while custom game logic modules handle win detection and board state management. Networking components facilitate engaging multiplayer interactions, integrating secure communication protocols to sync gameplay in real time. This project advanced my skills in modular design, state management, and modern Android development practices.

title: Lite Weather
subtitle: Minimalist & Weather Forecasts for iOS
description: A minimalist weather app offering precise forecasts for up to five days with real-time location tracking.
descriptionLong: Lite Weather is a SwiftUI-based app offering precise weather forecasts for up to five days. It leverages CoreLocation for real-time location tracking and Open-Meteo API for weather data. The app features a clean, intuitive UI with dynamic weather icons and detailed daily forecasts, ensuring users receive timely and accurate weather updates.

title: Rentingforce Expo App
subtitle: Rebuilding an old React Native app using Expo
description: Migrating and modernizing the RentingForce mobile app from React Native to Expo.
descriptionLong: The RentingForce Expo App is a React Native project that I worked on as a student. My task was to assist the main developer in transitioning the existing application to Expo, replacing old, unmaintained dependencies with modern solutions. The migration aimed to improve maintainability, performance, and ease of development. Key contributions included refactoring core components, ensuring compatibility with Expo, fixing issues related to dependency conflicts, implementing a new state management strategy, and enhancing UI/UX consistency. The project also involved working with authentication flows, navigation updates, and optimizing performance for smoother user interactions.

title: Verendus UI Library
subtitle: Reusable Components for Modern Web Applications
description: A comprehensive UI library developed during a seven-week internship for Verendus.
descriptionLong: During my internship with a fellow student, we developed a modern UI library for Verendus. Built with React and TypeScript, the library leverages Storybook for interactive component documentation. Using Vite and NX for a streamlined development experience, our library features modular, reusable components designed with accessibility and scalability in mind.
